With regards to Unresolved: “Perrin stepping willingly over the edge of a towering cliff while saying, "It must be done. I must learn to fly before I reach the bottom."” I always read that as being about Perrin's rescue of Faile from Tel'aran'rhiod. He steps willingly into the hedgehog ter'angreal's sleep-prison, and learns a limited form of control over it by the time he rescues Faile.
